
# Hide and Seek

A 3D survival game of exploration on an abandoned factory filled with treasures and unknown enemies inspired from the book Roadside Picnic by the Strugatsky brothers.

![image](https://image-forwarder.notaku.)

## Roadmap

- Stable game demo by Summer 2025
